title: Local Weyl modules and skew Howe duality
summary: The skew $(\mathfrak{gl}_{n}, \mathfrak{gl}_{r})$ Howe duality states that the exterior algebra $Λ(\mathbb{C}^{nr})$ admits a multiplicity-free decomposition under the natural actions of $\mathfrak{gl}_{n}\times \mathfrak{gl}_{r}$. In this paper, by using certain Lagrange interpolation polynomials of degree $r-1$, we extend the action of $\mathfrak{gl}_{n}$ on $Λ(\C^{nr})$ to its loop algebra $L(\mathfrak{gl}_{n})$.
